items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: No, he wasn't. He was a good clarinet player, though.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you ever hear Big Eye Louie much? Louie Nelson? Yeah, I never heard him much. I never didn't worry about him too much.
Wasn't one of your favorites, then? No, he wasn't. He was a good clarinet player, though. Man, that's one of them. Freddie Kepler men's, too. He was Freddie Kepler for quite a while, though.

But I never didn't take to him much. What about Piku? How did he rank? Of course, we heard him when he was pretty old, you know. We never heard him when he was really young. Did he sound much different when he was young?
